title: Common Ground
description: A community investment platform that helps neighbors turn shared priorities into visible, fundable action. I led the end-to-end product experience, from a new contribution model to the visual language that makes progress feel tangible.

title: Soft Focus
description: A slower, more intentional way to save and revisit the things that inspire us. Soft Focus pairs a tactile collection experience with a quiet recommendation engine built around context, not clicks.

title: Second Nature
description: Making everyday climate choices legible, motivating, and a little less lonely. This mobile companion turns household habits into a shared ritual with an optimistic, data-informed voice.
